annotations.title: Track an app in AI answers

description: Use this when the user wants to start tracking whether AI assistants recommend their app. Starts (or updates) tracking whether ChatGPT, Google AI Mode and Google AI Overviews recommend an app. Creates the project if it does not exist. Give every name the app goes by, its own domains, its App Store id or Play package, and the competitors to compare against.

aliases.description: Names the app goes by in answers, e.g. ["Damson", "Damson PCOS"].

country.description: Where the questions are asked from, e.g. US.

runs_per_day.description: How many times a day each question is asked on each engine (0 pauses the daily runs).
